summary: Verified descender clipping fix on masked headline reveals across Home, About, and xoExam product hero. The '.mask-line' rule in /app/frontend/src/index.css correctly uses padding-bottom:0.2em with equal negative margin-bottom, so the clip box extends downward to reveal descenders while line-spacing remains unchanged. Confirmed via computed styles and visual screenshots in both default and toggled themes.

home_/.descenders_visible: p in 'appointment', y in 'system'/'eyewear' fully rendered

about_/about.descenders_visible: p in 'depend', y in 'you', pp in 'happen' fully rendered

verification_details.theme_toggle: Works via [data-testid='theme-toggle']; html.dark class applied after click; no clipping introduced

critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is clean and idiomatic: padding-bottom + equal negative margin-bottom cancels layout impact while extending the overflow:hidden clip region. Line-height on the h1 wrappers remains unchanged (parent lineHeight equals fontSize, confirming leading-[0.94/0.96/0.97] tight settings preserved).
Minor pre-existing (unrelated) console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — not related to this fix, likely a framer-motion scroll offset warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 1-3 already validated broader site. Iteration 4 specifically validated the '.mask-line' descender fix. CSS is in /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 228-235. If reviewing further hero pages (System, Team, News, Contact, ProductHero variants), same .mask-line class applies globally so fix is consistent.
